tools.name: solve
tools.description:
Solves a linear, quadratic or mixed-integer optimisation model and returns the solution state, the objective value and each variable's value by name. Give the model as text, in LP format unless 'format' says otherwise. For example:
Maximize
 obj: 3 x + 5 y
Subject To
 budget: x + y <= 10
Bounds
 0 <

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Rewrites an optimisation model from one file format to another: LP (CPLEX LP format), MPS, or EBM (ojAlgo's own).

tools.name: environment
tools.description: Reports what a model solved here may be: how large, how long it may run, and which solvers are available.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "solve" is 1160 chars, far longer than this server's median (113). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
